question: What claim is made about the visibility of that circle to one devoted to worship and meditation, given its position?
premises: Vision of that circle occurs from afar.
This holds in relation to that circle.
It holds for one devoted to worship and meditation.
inference: For one devoted to worship and meditation, the circle becomes visible even from afar.
plain_english: And vision of that circle comes from afar to one devoted to worship and meditation.
